title: Local Project Coordinator
description:
To Apply

Send a cover letter, resume, three references, and hourly salary requirements in Brazilian Real via e-mail to by Wednesday 21 January, 2026 . Please write “Campinas Local Project Coordinator” in the subject line of the e-mail. Only short-listed candidates will be contacted. Interviews will take place end of January. If selected, Pyxera Global may elect to use the Local Project Coordinator for future similar assignments.

Overview

Pyxera Global (), an NGO with offices around the world, will be managing a skills-based volunteering program in Campinas, Brazil scheduled to take place 8 July – 22 August 2026, with in person dates 15-22 August, 2026. Pyxera Global is looking to hire a part-time Local Project Coordinator currently residing in Campinas to provide project management and logistical support to the selected team of high-level corporate volunteers who will provide pro bono consulting services to local social sector organizations.

The selected Local Project Coordinator’s main responsibilities will include, but may not be limited to, the following:

Project Development & Implementation

  • Identify and select potential partner organizations (mostly social enterprises and nonprofits) and help to develop Scope of Works (SOWs) reflecting the specific areas of intervention requested by local host client organizations.
  • Support local partner organizations in preparing for the arrival of corporate volunteers and ensuring stakeholder meetings are arranged.
  • Participate in conference calls with corporate volunteers in advance of their arrival in Campinas.
  • Support corporate volunteers, providing advice and guidance around SOW delivery.
  • Act as the on-the-ground interface between Pyxera Global and partner organizations in Campinas, including regular correspondence with Pyxera Global staff and other stakeholders to assure satisfaction on the part of the corporate volunteers and partner organizations.
  • Participate in meetings with corporate volunteers and with host client organizations, as requested.
  • Prepare financial and final program reports.

Logistics

  • Assist in procuring and negotiating accommodation and transportation in Campinas for corporate volunteers.
  • Coordinate the program launch and closing event(s) for corporate volunteers and host client organizations.
  • Prepare Campinas-related guides and suggestions for project guides.
  • Orient new corporate volunteers upon arrival in Campinas.
  • Manage project travel logistics for corporate volunteers while they are in Campinas.
  • Act as a logistical and informational resource for corporate volunteers and troubleshoot challenges they may face.
  • Monitor and advise on security arrangements for corporate volunteers when they are in Campinas.
  • Other logistical tasks such as restaurant bookings, photography recruitment, etc.

Knowledge and Skill Requirements

  1. Must be based in Campinas with in-depth area familiarity.
  2. College degree in project management, organizational development, sustainability, NGO management, communications, or related field.
  3. Knowledge or network of NGOs or social enterprises supporting STEM education, skills-trade training, and/or workforce development
  4. Minimum of 5-10 years of experience.
  5. Exceptional writing and communications skills.
  6. Ability to conduct Gap and SWOT analysis and to develop consulting Scopes of Work with limited supervision.
  7. Experience working with cross-cultural teams and/or skills-based volunteering programs.
  8. Ability to multi-task and manage diverse tasks simultaneously.
  9. Flexible and able to work in a team, as well as individually with limited supervision.
  10. Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  11. Fluent in English.
  12. Exceptional customer service, communication, and problem-solving skills.
  13. Experience in virtual and in-person presentation skills.

Salary

This is a part-time consultant position with an estimated timeline of 5-6 months with an immediate start date with a Scoping Trip in March with the Program Manager and the program taking place in August. Pay is based on past experience and the type of work required for this position. The selected local project coordinator will be paid in Brazilian Real of the country in which the work is completed.

title: Assistente financeiro
description:
Sobre a Ampulheta

A Ampulheta não é um BPO Financeiro. Acreditamos que finanças vão além do pagamento de contas e emissão de notas fiscais. É preciso estratégia, indicadores e planejamento para um crescimento sustentável.

Por isso, somos uma empresa de terceirização que assume 100% do financeiro dos nossos clientes — da operação à estratégia financeira.

Não somos suporte. Somos o cérebro financeiro por trás de empresas que querem crescer com consistência.

Por quê?

Porque o empresário brasileiro vive apagando incêndio — e nós existimos para devolver a ele o que mais vale: visão, tempo e direção.

O que você irá fazer aqui?

Como Assessor(a) Financeiro(a) , você será responsável pela execução das rotinas financeiras de uma carteira de 7 a 10 clientes B2B — todos negócios reais, com desafios reais.

Você vai operar o financeiro com excelência e ajudar o Head da sua BU a tomar decisões estratégicas com base em dados confiáveis e uma execução sem ruído.

Suas responsabilidades:

  • Gestão de contas a pagar e a receber
  • Conciliação bancária e controle de caixa
  • Emissão de notas fiscais e boletos
  • Agendamento de pagamentos
  • Cobrança e contato com inadimplentes
  • Relacionamento direto com clientes
  • Apoio na construção de previsões de fluxo de caixa

Você será parte de uma Business Unit com dois Assessores + um Head .

Juntos, vocês atendem de 15 a 20 empresas — com método, clareza e obsessão por resultado.

Quem estamos procurando?

Não buscamos alguém "comprometido" e "proativo".

Isso é o mínimo.

Buscamos alguém com visão de longo prazo.

Alguém que sabe o impacto de um caixa saudável.

Alguém que resolve antes que vire problema.

E, principalmente, alguém sem a mentalidade de CLT. Aqui somos movidos pela meritocracia.

Se você já trabalhou ou trabalha como PJ, isso será um diferencial.

Requisitos Técnicos (Hard Skills)

  • Experiência com contas a pagar/receber, conciliação e fluxo de caixa
  • Excel intermediário/avançado
  • Domínio de ferramentas como Nibo, Conta Azul, Omie será um baita diferencial.
  • Emissão de notas fiscais, leitura de extratos, organização documental
  • Vivência com empresas de serviços B2B

Requisitos Comportamentais (Soft Skills)

  • Clareza, disciplina e organização no dia a dia
  • Senso de urgência com estabilidade emocional
  • Boa comunicação (simples, direta e profissional)
  • Sede de aprender e de entregar melhor do que foi pedido
  • Capacidade de gerir múltiplos clientes com autonomia

Quem não se encaixa aqui?

  • Quem acha que "tá bom assim"
  • Quem espera alguém dizendo o que fazer o tempo todo
  • Quem não aguenta pressão saudável nem feedback direto
  • Quem trabalha no piloto automático

O que você encontra aqui?

  • Uma rotina com método, clareza e constância
  • Um time que se importa com o cliente e com a entrega
  • Reconhecimento baseado em impacto real — não esforço simbólico
  • Crescimento na prática, não só no discurso
  • Modelo híbrido e autonomia com responsabilidade

Remuneração Mensal?

  • De R$ 4.000,00 a R$ 5.500,00 (progressivo)

Como se candidatar?

Responda as perguntas e aplique sua candidatura

Último aviso:

Se você acredita que rotina financeira bem feita salva empresa — e quer fazer parte de um time que não se contenta com o básico — então vem.

A Ampulheta não é para todo mundo.

É para quem sabe o que está fazendo. E quer fazer melhor ainda.

title: Data Product Manager - Lending & Pay Later
description:
Role Summary:

We are looking for a Data Product Manager to build and manage the data ecosystem powering our lending and pay later products . The ideal candidate will have experience in micro-lending or digital credit platforms , with a deep understanding of how data flows through the lending lifecycle — from origination to repayment.

You will define how data is collected, structured, and leveraged for credit decisioning, business insights, and AI deployment , ensuring that data becomes a core enabler for smarter, faster lending decisions.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own the data roadmap across the lending and pay-later ecosystem.
  • Map and manage all data sources involved in the credit lifecycle (KYC, transaction, repayment, behavioral, and bureau data).
  • Design and optimize data pipelines that support credit scoring, risk modeling, and AI systems.
  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Data Science teams to ensure data integrity, accessibility, and usability .
  • Define data requirements for new products, features, and risk models.
  • Build dashboards and metrics to monitor portfolio performance and business health.
  • Enable AI and ML model deployment by ensuring high-quality, structured, and real-time data availability.
  • Partner with compliance and BI teams to ensure data governance and regulatory alignment.

Key Requirements:

  • 5+ years of experience in data or product management roles within lending, BNPL, or fintech ecosystems .
  • Strong understanding of credit data, decision engines, and lending workflows .
  • Experience with data platforms, APIs, and BI tools (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, Power BI, or Looker).
  • Familiarity with AI/ML use cases in credit risk, collections, and personalization .
  • Strong analytical mindset with ability to translate business needs into scalable data solutions.
  • Proven cross-functional collaboration skills with product, data, and risk teams.

A Hyundai Motor Company, sediada na Coreia do Sul, está passando por uma transição significativa de ser fabricante de automóveis para se tornar provedora de soluções de mobilidade inteligente. Para acelerar a concretização dessa mudança, estamos investindo em tecnologias inovadoras que transformarão a maneira como as pessoas interagem com suas soluções de mobilidade e melhorarão sua qualidade de vida.

Comprometida com a sustentabilidade, a Hyundai iniciou medidas para liderar uma era de mobilidade mais sustentável eletrificando sua linha de produtos e expandindo seus negócios de hidrogênio para veículos comerciais e dispositivos de utilidade. Além da mobilidade, confiaremos na economia circular para moldar um futuro mais sustentável que beneficiará não apenas a Hyundai como empresa, mas a sociedade como um todo.

A Hyundai Motor Brasil começou suas operações em 2012, introduzindo o modelo único HB20 no mercado local, projetado e desenvolvido especificamente para o país. Atualmente, a empresa atua como sede regional para a América Central e do Sul, exportando do Brasil para Uruguai, Paraguai, Colômbia e México. Com perspectivas promissoras para a região, a Hyundai Motor Brasil, também conhecida como Hyundai Motor Central & South América, está introduzindo tecnologia de ponta de modelos premiados mundialmente, como o IONIQ 5, e avançando para implementar soluções movidas a hidrogênio junto com ações sociais e ambientais para contribuir com as sociedades onde opera na região. Se você aspira fazer parte de uma equipe líder em inovação na indústria automotiva, venha se juntar a nós na Hyundai e faça parte desta jornada rumo ao sucesso.

Movimento audacioso, energia positiva e trabalho de qualidade; este é o nosso DNA Hyundai; este foi o poder que nos permitiu ser líder global na indústria automotiva e será o poder para criar um novo mundo. Estamos em busca de talentos que escreverão uma nova página de nossa história com o DNA Hyundai.

Venha crescer conosco!!!

Sobre a MAPFRE

Você já pensou em trabalhar em uma das maiores seguradoras do mundo? Além de ter o maior e mais completo portfólio do mercado, trabalhamos para proteger milhões de sonhos, vidas, bens e temos como missão cuidar do que é importante para você e nossos clientes, garantindo segurança, tranquilidade e proteção.

Aqui na MAPFRE contribuímos para uma sociedade mais sustentável, solidária e inclusiva. Temos o compromisso em apoiar diversidade, construindo um ambiente com igualdade e equidade. Valorizamos e apoiamos a presença de mulheres em cargo de gestão, a contratação de pessoa com deficiência e o equilíbrio racial e de gênero em nossas equipes.

O Analista de Riscos e Compliance será responsável por monitorar, avaliar e garantir a aderência às políticas internas, regulamentações do mercado financeiro e normas da CVM, ANBIMA e SUSEP, assegurando a mitigação de riscos operacionais, de mercado e regulatórios nos fundos de investimento. Dentre as principais atividades, estão:

  • Realizar análise e monitoramento dos riscos de mercado, crédito, liquidez e operacional dos fundos;
  • Implementar e acompanhar controles internos para garantir conformidade com regulamentos e políticas;
  • Elaborar relatórios gerenciais e indicadores de risco para suporte à tomada de decisão;
  • Monitorar limites regulatórios e internos, identificando desvios e propondo ações corretivas;
  • Apoiar auditorias internas e externas, fornecendo documentação e evidências;
  • Acompanhar mudanças regulatórias e atualizar processos e políticas conforme necessário;

O que a MAPFRE espera de você:

  • Ensino superior completo;
  • Excel avançado (incluindo VBA para automação) e/ou demais ferramentas Dados;
  • Conhecimento e experiência em extração, tratamento, análise e apresentação de Dados;
  • Conhecimento em regulamentação : CVM, ANBIMA, Bacen e normas internacionais (ex.: IFRS);
  • Gestão de riscos : Modelos quantitativos, Value at Risk (VaR), Stress Testing, análise de sensibilidade;
  • Compliance : Políticas de prevenção à lavagem de dinheiro (PLD), KYC, due diligence;
  • Mercado financeiro : Produtos de investimento, derivativos, renda fixa e variável;
  • Análise de dados : Interpretação de indicadores e métricas de risco;
  • Sistemas de gestão de risco e Plataformas de compliance;

A jornada diária conta com horário flexível, formato de trabalho híbrido, incentivo a saúde e qualidade de vida com Plano de Saúde, Assistência Odontológica, Auxílio Academia, Vale-Refeição, Vale-Alimentação, Incentivo a Previdência Privada, Day-off de aniversário, Vale-Transporte ou Fretado, PLR, condições especiais na contratação de seguros da MAPFRE, auxílio babá ou creche, Universidade Corporativa, descontos para estudos e seguro de Vida.

title: Medical Director
description:
About our company:

Werfen: Global Leader in In Vitro Diagnostics

Founded in 1966, Werfen is one of t he world's leading companies in the development, manufacturing, and distribution of specialized diagnostic instruments, reagents, process automation solutions, and data management systems that empower patient care in hospitals and laboratories worldwide.

Our solutions in Hemostasis, Acute Care Diagnostics, Autoimmunity, Transplantation, and Transfusion are available in over 100 countries and territories through our direct operations and distributors. We are a team of more than 7,000 employees with an annual revenue exceeding $2 billion , reflecting our global presence in the industry.

In Brazil, we ar e leaders in diagnostic solutions for Hemostasis and Blood Gas Analysis . We have an office in Barueri (Alphaville), São Paulo , and a distribution center in Itajaí, Santa Catarina , providing our customers across the country with excellence and efficiency.

Position Summary:

The main role is to lead and execute the Medical strategy in the home country, as well as support initiatives for Latin America in a collaborative manner. The position aims to generate business demand by increasing the visibility of products and solutions through a clinical/scientific approach, influencing physicians, professional societies, and healthcare institutions, and promoting the adoption of these solutions as the standard of care, in order to achieve sales objectives.

Key Responsabilities:

  • Develop and lead the medical strategy, ensuring clinical excellence and regulatory compliance.
  • Collaborate with executive leaders to align medical objectives with the company's vision and mission.
  • Oversee the implementation of effective clinical practices and ensure adherence to regulatory standards.
  • Participate in strategic decision-making related to the development of new products and portfolio expansion.
  • Create, validate, and effectively communicate scientific information related to the company's products. This involves translating complex scientific data into clear and persuasive messages that support the perception and acceptance of our medical products in the market.
  • Establish and maintain strategic relationships with societies, opinion leaders, physicians, laboratory professionals, and other healthcare specialists. The goal is to understand their needs, share relevant product information, and gather valuable feedback that contributes to continuous improvement.
  • Design educational and promotional plans for the scientific community.
  • Plan and execute programs and activities aimed at improving the skills, knowledge, and competencies of teams interacting with clients, such as sales, marketing, and others.
  • Provide leadership and guidance to medical professionals and clinical staff in the context of diagnostic and medical devices.
  • Participate in resolving issues related to the company's products and services.
  • Stay updated on medical advancements, regulations, and trends specific to the diagnostic and medical device industry.

Skills and Competences

  • Deep Knowledge in Medicine and Health Sciences: Expertise in relevant therapeutic areas, clinical protocols, and regulatory guidelines.
  • Planning and Execution of Clinical Trials: Ability to design, manage, and evaluate clinical trials effectively.
  • Understanding of GCP and Regulatory Guidelines: Knowledge of Good Clinical Practice (GCP) and local and international regulatory standards.
  • Scientific Publications and Data Communication: Experience in writing and reviewing scientific publications and in communicating research data clearly and persuasively.

Minimum Knowledge and Experience Required for the Role (education, experience, and training):

1.Education:

  • Professional with training in Healthcare areas (Medicine, Pharmacist, Chemistry, Biology, genetics or any other health sciences).

2.Experience:

  • More than 5 years of experience in the healthcare industry (pharmaceutical industry or medical device) or in medical affairs.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of Good Clinical Practice (GCP) guidelines and applicable clinical practice guidelines, as well as the healthcare ecosystem in which the role will operate.

title: Chief Estimator and Industry Specialist
description:
About TrueBuilt:

TrueBuilt is the only cloud-based AI takeoff and estimation platform built specifically for commercial contractors. Top builders leverage our computer vision and AI solutions to increase takeoff + estimation speed by 200%. Take advantage of moving your cost and projects databases to the cloud in order to achieve max flexibility while reducing IT cost and complexity. Our AI Document Assistant, Flexible estimation engine, and Supplier Management modules further supercharge builders to mitigate risk and win new bids at scale. TrueBuilt offers unparalleled flexibility, seamlessly integrating with existing solutions or serving as a comprehensive standalone platform.

We are seeking an experienced Industry Specialist/Estimator to join our dynamic team and contribute to our mission of transforming the way builders approach preconstruction.

Responsibilities:

As an Industry Specialist/Preconstruction Manager at TrueBuilt, you will play a crucial role in bridging the gap between our product development team and the needs of the preconstruction industry. 

Your primary responsibilities will include:

Industry Expertise:

  • Utilize your deep understanding of preconstruction processes, including takeoff/estimation, bid management, and qualification/risk management.
  • Stay updated on industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices related to preconstruction software and workflows.
  • Conduct market research and competitive analysis to identify gaps and opportunities in the preconstruction software landscape.
  • Act as a subject matter expert and provide insights and guidance to the product development team.

Prospective Sales Support:

  • Collaborate with the TrueBuilt sales team to win new business and onboard new customers to the TrueBuilt Platform
  • Ability to conduct product demos for prospective customers along with industry knowledge to showcase TrueBuilt's preconstruction software and its value proposition.

Customer Engagement and Support:

  • Engage with customers, industry professionals, and stakeholders to understand their pain points, challenges, and needs.
  • Collaborate with Customer Support to identify customer pain points.
  • Provide training, support, and guidance to customers in adopting and maximizing the use of TrueBuilt's software solutions.

Content Creation:

  • Contribute to thought leadership content, including blog posts, whitepapers, and industry presentations, to establish TrueBuilt as a trusted authority in preconstruction.
  • Represent TrueBuilt at industry events, conferences, and webinars to share insights and network with industry professionals.
  • Act as an ambassador for TrueBuilt, building relationships with industry influencers and fostering partnerships.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent industry experience).
  • 6+ years of experience with OST, Quickbid & Planswift.
  • Proven experience in preconstruction roles, including takeoff/estimation and bid management.
  • Strong knowledge of preconstruction software and tools, such as takeoff/estimation software, bid management platforms, and qualification/risk management solutions.
  • Experience in product management or a strong understanding of product development processes.
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to articulate complex concepts in a clear and concise manner.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify opportunities, drive insights, and make data-driven decisions.
  • Ability to work collaboratively across teams, bridging the gap between technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Passion for innovation, technology, and driving positive change in the construction industry.

If you are a passionate industry professional with a strong understanding of preconstruction workflows and the desire to shape the future of preconstruction software, we want to hear from you. Join the TrueBuilt team and be part of our mission to empower builders with game-changing technology solutions.

To apply, please submit your resume here. 

Note: Only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

Benefits:

  • Competitive salary, equity, and the opportunity to build an amazing company from the ground up
  • Remote-first workplace
  • Routine team meetups
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage

description:

title: Lead Data Platform Architect
description:
Lead Data Platform Architect

Mars is a family-owned business with more than $50 billion in global sales. We produce some of the world’s best-loved brands: M&M’s®, SNICKERS®, TWIX®, MILKY WAY®, DOVE®, PEDIGREE®, ROYAL CANIN®, WHISKAS®, EXTRA®, ORBIT®, 5™, SKITTLES®, BEN’S ORIGINAL®, and COCOAVIA®. Alongside our consumer brands, we proudly take care of half of the world’s pets through our nutrition, health and services businesses such as Banfield Pet Hospitals™, BluePearl®, Linnaeus, AniCura, VCA™ and Pet Partners™. Headquartered in McLean, VA, Mars operates in more than 80 countries. The Mars Five Principles – Quality, Responsibility, Mutuality, Efficiency and Freedom – inspire our 160,000 Diverse Associates to act daily towards creating the world we want tomorrow.

The Lead Data Platform Architect is instrumental in delivering scalable, repeatable and agile data and platform architectures to unlock and drive business value across Finance, Commercial, R&D, MGS Labs and Innovation:

As the Lead Data Platform Architect in the Enterprise Data & Platform team, your key responsibilities are as follows:

TECHNICAL PROFICIENCY AND LEADERSHIP

  • Lead the definition and execution of data architecture strategies across multiple business domains and data platforms.
  • Drive the development of scalable, integrated data models and architectures across raw, trusted, and harmonized zones.
  • Define and execute the data product strategy for assigned business areas in collaboration with analytics and business teams.
  • Act as a thought leader and trusted advisor, supporting teams in understanding business objectives, data requirements, processes, and enabling technologies.
  • Ensure all data architecture efforts are aligned with the broader business vision and strategic priorities and provide architectural oversight across delivery initiatives.
  • Collaborate with other data architects to ensure consistent and integrated use of data assets across the organization.
  • Identify cross-segment and cross-function data dependencies or issues and lead resolution efforts.
  • Provide strategic guidance on data domains, process analysis, data analysis, and modelling techniques.
  • Mentor and coach solution / data architects and engineers to build internal data architecture capability.
  • Advocate for best practices, tools, and methods related to data architecture.
  • Ensure understanding and compliance of data protection policies, security policies, and GDPR

DELIVERABLE INVOLVEMENT & OWNERSHIP

  • Reference Architectures: Own and maintain reusable architectural patterns
  • High-Level Designs (HLDs): Review and approve HLDs from Solution Architects and 3rd parties
  • Key Design Decisions (KDDs): Own and govern major architectural decisions for alignment with the Architecture Review Board and beyond
  • Architecture Option Assessments: Lead decisioning on tooling, modelling, and patterns

DATA & PLATFORM ARCHITECTURE OWNERSHIP

  • Develop and maintain current and future state data architectures, models, and roadmaps.
  • Promote awareness and understanding of data architectures across the organization.
  • Review and validate high-level models and reference architecture libraries
  • Approve changes to shared or enterprise-wide data models

Knowledge and Experience

ESSENTIAL:

  • Previous experience as a Senior Data or Platform Architect essential
  • Proven experience as a senior data or platform architect, or similar leadership role in data & platform strategy.
  • Strong background in data modelling, architecture frameworks, and modern data integration methods.
  • Deep understanding of cloud-based data platforms (Azure) and tools (Databricks, SQL, ADF etc) as well as analytics solutions.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence and align across business and technology functions.
  • Experience building and evolving data & platform architectures that scale and adapt to changing business needs.
  • Passion for coaching and enabling others with a collaborative leadership approach.
  • Knowledgeable in Data Source systems (eg. SAP) and Data Lake technology
  • Stakeholder management and communication skills
  • Strong interpersonal skills
  • Fluent in writing and speaking English

DESIRED:

  • Previous experience in CPG industry would be ideal
  • Experience at operating in a complex global matrix organisation
  • Experience at collaborating with cross-functional partners
  • High drive for results and an ability to work with minimum input

What can you expect from Mars?

  • Work with diverse and talented Associates, all guided by the Five Principles.
  • Join a purpose-driven company, where we’re striving to build the world we want tomorrow, today.
  • Best-in-class learning and development support from day one, including access to our in-house Mars University.
  • An industry-competitive salary and benefits package, including a company bonus.

Mars is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you need assistance or an accommodation during the application process because of a disability, it is available upon request. The company is pleased to provide such assistance, and no applicant will be penalized as a result of such a request.

title: Indirect Tax Manager
description:
About Us:

Temu tax team ensures compliance with local and international tax laws while optimizing the company’s tax position. We handle tax planning, reporting, and risk management, working closely with other departments to drive efficiencies. Our dynamic team offers growth opportunities in a fast-paced, evolving environment, valuing accuracy and innovative problem-solving.

We are seeking a proactive and experienced Tax BP to support our tax compliance and audit activities in Brazil. This role will be critical in ensuring full compliance with Brazilian tax regulations, managing tax audits, and acting as a key liaison between internal teams and external tax authorities. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of Brazilian tax legislation, excellent communication skills in both Portuguese and English, and the ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

Job description

  1. The Tax Senior/Manager will be responsible for the management of indirect taxes, tax compliance and tax planning, ensuring compliance with current legislation and the optimization of the tax burden;
  2. Ensure timely and accurate preparation and filing of all tax returns (direct and indirect taxes), including PIS/COFINS, ICMS, ISS, etc.
  3. Monitor tax compliance processes and work closely with internal accounting and finance teams to ensure tax obligations are met.
  4. Manage and respond to federal, state, and municipal tax audits, including coordinating documentation and liaising with auditors and tax authorities.
  5. Analyze changes in Brazilian tax legislation and assess potential business impacts, providing recommendations for compliance.

Desired profile

  1. Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or Law. Advanced degree or CPA certification preferred.
  2. Solid experience in indirect taxes, tax compliance and tax planning;
  3. Knowledge in Tax reform;
  4. Excellent interpersonal skills and communication skills with different stakeholders;

Language:

  • Fluent in Portuguese (native proficiency).
  • Fluent in English (written & spoken) – must liaise with global teams.

At Temu, we are proud to be an employer that builds a diverse community. We encourage all qualified individuals to apply and join our team. We are dedicated to providing a work environment free from discrimination and harassment, where all employees are treated with respect and dignity.

Apply today to join Temu and be part of a dynamic and innovative company.

description:
This position will lead the finance function of Brazil as it is part of the Global Accounting & Control organization, and the position responsibilities include:

  1. Manage and lead the Accounting and Controlling function, including the implementation of consistent and effective business processes that enhance the Share Service Centers
  2. Provide primary coordination for activities and alignment between Finance, Accounting and Controllership, Tax, Treasury, SSC, AP, AR and other areas

Management of general accounting processes including historical financial reporting

Manage the internal control environment including SOX compliance as well as point of contact for internal and external audits.

Provide support for general legal, administrative, and statutory requirements.

Title : Director - Regional CMC

Location : Brazil, Remote

Experience : Min 15 years in Regulatory Affairs, CMC

Director – Regional CMC

Objective:

The Director – Regional CMC will manage the Regional CMC team, ensuring seamless integration between global Regulatory CMC strategies and local affiliate execution. This role is pivotal in driving regional alignment, efficiency, and consistency in post-approval submissions across a diverse product portfolio, including small molecules, biologics, vaccines, and plasma-derived therapies. The Director – Regional CMC will champion the development and implementation of regional strategies, fostering collaboration and process improvement to meet regulatory requirements effectively and efficiently.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Oversee and manage the Regional CMC team, providing guidance, training, and support to ensure high performance and professional development.
  • Foster a collaborative and inclusive team environment, promoting knowledge sharing and best practices.
  • Develop and execute a strategic vision for the Regional CMC Liaison function, aligning with global Regulatory CMC objectives.
  • Ensure the team is equipped with the necessary skills, knowledge, and resources to excel in their roles.
  • Translate global CMC strategies into comprehensive regional plans, ensuring alignment with country-specific regulatory requirements.
  • Oversee the development and implementation of regional submission strategies to streamline processes and reduce duplication of effort.
  • Partner with global and regional stakeholders to identify opportunities for harmonization and efficiency.
  • Monitor and report on submission timelines and regulatory approvals, addressing any issues or delays proactively.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with local affiliates to understand and address country-specific regulatory needs and challenges.
  • Liaise with global Regulatory CMC teams to provide regional insights and feedback, ensuring a cohesive approach to regulatory submissions.
  • Represent the Regional CMC Liaison function in cross-functional and global meetings, advocating for regional needs and perspectives.
  • Identify and address bottlenecks in the regional submission process, proposing and implementing innovative solutions to enhance efficiency.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives, leveraging best practices and lessons learned to optimize regional submission processes.
  • Ensure compliance with regional and country-specific regulatory requirements and guidelines.

Education & Competencies (Technical and Behavioral):

  • BS/BA Degree in a Scientific Discipline, Advanced Degree (M.S), with Ph.D. preferred.
  • 15+ years of seasoned biopharmaceutical/device industry experience or with a regulatory agency is preferred, while leading major submissions during LCM, development - including preparation of NDA/NLA/MAA.
  • Equivalent industry experience with direct technical/product development experience such as Pharmaceutical Development, Analytical Development, Production, Quality Assurance can be considered.
  • People leadership experience (5+ years) required.
  • Highly proficient understanding of scientific principles and profound grasp of global regulatory CMC requirements relevant to global drug development and post-market support.
  • Keeping abreast of industry insights and regulatory trends to drive organizational evolution.
  • Proven ability to understand and communicate regulatory strategy to drug development, registration, and post-market support teams.
  • Analyze issues with attention to detail.
  • Ability to assess and scientifically justify alternative approaches.
  • Base regulatory strategy recommendations on precedents and other regulatory intelligence as well as regulations and guidelines.
  • Able to deal with issues of critical importance independently.
  • Exercises excellent judgment in elevating and communicating actual or potential issues to line management.
  • Understands who is responsible for different decisions, drives and escalates as necessary.
  • Implements the directions taken by the company, leading with agility through evolving landscapes.
  • Intentionally promotes an inclusive culture, leveraging individual strengths for team success.
  • Develops and drives prioritization framework, managing shifting priorities and tight deadlines.
  • Exceptional skills in written and oral communication.
  • Demonstrates excellent skills in leadership, collaboration, negotiation, problem solving, and fostering interpersonal connections through teamwork.

title: Technical Support Engineer (Tier 2)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Technical Support Engineer with 2+ years of software support experience to join our U.S. client's customer support team. In this role, you will provide daily technical support, assisting customers in resolving their software and compliance-related issues. You will work closely with the Sales, Customer Success, Engineering, and Product teams, and you will have access to tool subscriptions, such as Enterprise ChatGPT, Grammarly, and GitHub Copilot (if required), to deliver exceptional support.

Our client makes trust-building in business relationships effortless. With greater trust comes greater business growth. At their core, our client takes the drudgery out of compliance by automating critical compliance activities and bringing joy into a traditionally drab space. The client's software platform enables companies to quickly and cost-effectively adopt formal security and privacy programs, measure their efficacy against compliance standards, and share achievements with customers via AI to answer security questionnaires. As a result, compliance becomes habitual, simple to understand and implement, and continuously verifiable, allowing businesses to gain transparency into their compliance status.

Responsibilities

  • Drive resolution of customer issues, act as a customer advocate, and maintain happy and satisfied customers
  • Follow the client's customer support process and meet established service level agreements (SLAs)
  • Triage support requests by conducting a first-level investigation of technical product issues
  • Provide continuous and timely updates on issue resolution status to customers and key internal stakeholders
  • Engage with the Engineering team to ensure timely resolution of customer issues according to SLAs and escalate when necessary to meet those goals

Required Experience

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • University degree with a major in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field
  • 2+ years of customer support experience for a commercial software product
  • Passion for providing technical support to customers and helping them gain success using client products
  • Demonstrated ability to investigate and troubleshoot product issues by reproducing the problem, examining application logs, and reviewing debug messages and stack traces
  • Strong problem-solving capabilities in a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) application environment
  • First point of customer contact and an ability to act independently, as well as a willingness to involve a manager and others when in need of assistance
  • A quick learner who is inquisitive about new products and features
  • Career-minded and willing to take on the responsibilities of learning new software development languages and tools while still maintaining an exceptionally high standard of support delivery
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent

Preferred Experience

  • Demonstrated capabilities using the Chrome Browser Development Toolset when appropriate to solve specific problems
  • Experience with Atlassian/Jira
  • Experience with Linux commands and networking will be a significant advantage
  • Other skills that will help the candidate stand out are as follows:
  • REST APIs (in Postman)
  • JavaScript basics (any programming language)
  • Basic SQL commands
  • Log aggregation and monitoring tools, such as DataDog
  • Experience using project management tools, such as Jira

Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

Core Client Values

The client's values are threaded into the very fabric of their culture.

  • Trust : We strive to continuously earn the trust of our team, customers, investors, and all other stakeholders, proving we are dependable
  • Health : We are diligent caretakers of the health of the business, but never prioritize it over the mental and physical health of our team
  • Respect : We are passionate about being respectful and courteous. There's no excuse for being a jerk
  • Evidence-Based Decisions: Our strategy and operations are driven by evidence, which we collect from our customers, product, team, and partners
  • Accountability : We are fanatical about transparency and hold ourselves accountable for everything we do
  • Diversity : We work hard to nurture a team that is diverse in identity, belief, background, thought, and experience. Our diversity makes us stronger

The client celebrates diversity. Joyfully building a product that everyone loves requires a team with different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. It is why they are committed to bringing people on board from diverse backgrounds, races, religions, national origins, gender identities, sexual orientations, gender identities, ages, disabilities, or veteran statuses.

About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members for our clients. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS).

A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. A Motiva é o lugar certo para o seu talento, na qual você pode escolher o caminho que deseja seguir juntamente com uma empresa que promove a melhoria da qualidade de vida das pessoas por meio da mobilidade. Nos comprometemos em construir uma cultura cada vez mais diversa e valorizamos a inclusão de todas as pessoas independente de cor, etnia, religião, idade, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual ou deficiência, promovendo um ambiente inclusivo e com equidade de oportunidades.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Ser referência técnica em Datadog, apoiando a adoção da ferramenta e o uso de suas funcionalidades avançadas;

Atuar como especialista em observabilidade e resiliência, garantindo disponibilidade e performance em ambientes híbridos (nuvem e on-premises);

Definir, implementar e sustentar soluções de observabilidade ponta a ponta (métricas, logs, traces e alertas inteligentes);

Apoiar a resolução de incidentes críticos, realizar análises post-mortem e propor melhorias para aumentar resiliência e disponibilidade;

Automatizar rotinas de infraestrutura e operações utilizando Terraform, Ansible e pipelines de CI/CD;

Apoiar times de desenvolvimento na criação de pipelines e na adoção de práticas de entrega contínua;

Contribuir para estratégias de backup, recuperação de desastres (DR) e continuidade de negócios;

Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com arquitetura, desenvolvimento, segurança e infraestrutura para evolução do ecossistema;

Utilizar experiência prévia com containers (Docker, Kubernetes), automação e práticas de SLOs e SLIs para sustentar e evoluir os serviços de observabilidade.

Requisitos e qualificações

O que esperamos de você:

✅ Ensino Superior Completo em Engenharia, Ciências da Computação, Tecnologia da Informação, Segurança de TI;

✅ Experiência como SRE ou DevOps Engineer;

✅ Domínio da ferramenta Datadog para monitoramento e observabilidade;

✅ Vivência com automação e infraestrutura como código (Terraform, Ansible, Helm, GitLab CI/CD ou similares);

✅ Conhecimento em containers (Docker, Kubernetes) e integração com pipelines de CI/CD;

✅ Prática em definição, acompanhamento e sustentação de SLOs e SLIs;

✅ Experiência em ambientes híbridos e multicloud (AWS, Azure e On-Premises);

✅ Conhecimentos em resiliência, alta disponibilidade e recuperação de desastres (DR).

Você se destaca, se tiver:

✅ Certificações DataDog, Cloud (AWS, Azure) ou DevOps/SRE;

✅ Vivência com OpenShift e ambientes corporativos de containers;

✅ Experiência com ferramentas de observabilidade adicionais como Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, Loki, ArgoCD ou Jenkins;

✅ Atuação em ambientes regulados, garantindo conformidade e rastreabilidade.

Informações adicionais

Ao entrar para o nosso time integrado, você fará parte de uma empresa presente em 13 estados do país e que movimenta milhares de pessoas diariamente ao oferecer mobilidade de forma íntegra e que gera impacto positivo na sociedade. Aqui, você encontrará diversos benefícios para apoiar o seu desenvolvimento e dar mais movimento para a sua carreira.

title: Gerente SHE
description:
O Gerente de SHE é responsável pela implementação, otimização e gestão de processos da área de Segurança do Trabalho dentro de uma organização. Ele garante que a operação dos serviços seja eficientes, alinhadas com os objetivos estratégicos da área.

  • Assegurar o atendimento aos requisitos legais e corporativos aplicáveis a segurança do trabalho, objetivando a não ocorrência de acidentes e não conformidades.
  • Avaliar as condições ambientais de trabalho (riscos físicos), emitir relatório técnico e indicar medidas de controle.
  • Atuar imediatamente qualquer atividade que apresente risco grave e iminente de acidente do trabalho ou doença ocupacional.
  • Identificar e analisar riscos, acidentes e falhas, investigar as causas e propor medidas preventivas e corretivas para prevenir potenciais incidentes e/ou acidentes.
  • Acompanhar peritos e auditores nas avaliações ambientais e fiscalizações trabalhistas.

  • Monitorar os dados estatísticos de acidentes do trabalho, doenças profissionais e do trabalho, calcular a frequência e a gravidade.
  • Assegurar a gestão de equipe sob sua responsabilidade.
  • Promover a comunicação entre a Segurança e a gerência/diretoria dos sites.
  • Oferecer suporte ao negócio ao longo do ciclo de vida do projeto desde o planejamento, supervisão, monitoramento e documentação para assegurar a conformidade com os aspectos internos, externos e legais relacionados.

Requisitos:

Atividades:

title: Analista Comercial Sênior
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Acompanhar e analisar o orçamento e o planejamento comercial, utilizando ferramentas de controle e gestão, assegurando o cumprimento do planejamento anual e dos resultados do Shopping;
  • Conduzir negociações comerciais com lojistas, incluindo renovações, retenções, movimentações estratégicas e discussões contratuais, garantindo a sustentabilidade do mix e a performance comercial;
  • Atuar na gestão jurídica contratual, em interface com as áreas responsáveis, assegurando conformidade, prazos e mitigação de riscos;
  • Consolidar, analisar e garantir a confiabilidade das informações de NOI, bem como dos principais KPIs comerciais, por meio de análises críticas e relatórios gerenciais;
  • Elaborar estudos de performance e acompanhar indicadores como Taxa de Ocupação, Leasing Spread (LS), Novos Contratos e Renovações, propondo ações para maximização de resultados;
  • Elaborar apresentações comerciais e relatórios executivos para suporte à tomada de decisão;
  • Apoiar os executivos comerciais na prospecção e nos resultados de lojas, quiosques e mídias, por meio da avaliação estratégica do mix do shopping e aderência ao planejamento comercial;
  • Dar visibilidade aos processos e indicadores comerciais, promovendo comunicação efetiva entre as áreas financeira, auditoria, jurídica e marketing;
  • Atuar com foco na maximização de receitas, eficiência de custos e melhoria contínua dos resultados comerciais.

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Formação Superior completa em Administração, Comunicação, Economia, Engenharia de Produção, Direito ou áreas correlatas;
  • Pacote Office avançado (especialmente Excel);

Venha transformar sua paixão em carreira!

Responsabilidades :

  • Desenvolver e implementar estratégias de SEO com base em análises de dados e pesquisas.

auditoria de seo

seo tecnico

seo conteúdo

seo local on-page

saber wordpress

off-page linkbuilding, citations, press release

Comprometimento, proatividade e foco em resultados.

Oferecemos :

  • Vaga PJ Remota , com flexibilidade de horário.
  • Bonificação
  • Curso de Inglês
  • Oportunidade de trabalhar em uma agência de SEO Local focada em crescimento contínuo e resultados no mercado americano .
  • Ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo com desafios e aprendizado constante.
  • Cultura de aprendizado e apoio para o desenvolvimento contínuo.

Processo Seletivo:

  • Análise de currículo: Avaliaremos sua experiência e compatibilidade com a vaga.
  • Conversa com a equipe: Conhecimento da cultura da empresa e alinhamento de expectativas.

A Arcor é uma das maiores multinacionais de alimentos da América Latina, com marcas reconhecidas nos segmentos de biscoitos, chocolates e confeitos. Nossa atuação é pautada por segurança, qualidade, eficiência e desenvolvimento das pessoas, sempre com foco em resultados sustentáveis.

description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.

We are looking for a User Experience Specialist to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. - Proficient with analysis, troubleshooting, and problem-solving.

- Advanced English level.

If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Analista de Customer Experience
description:
Analista de Customer Experience

Quem somos

A Busbud é um grupo líder global em mobilidade focado em viagens interurbanas terrestres, com a missão de transformar a forma como as pessoas se conectam em todo o mundo. O grupo opera um mercado B2C focado na reserva de viagens interurbanas terrestres (ônibus, trem, caronas compartilhadas e muito mais), utilizado por mais de 100 milhões de viajantes em mais de 3 milhões de rotas em mais de 80 países. A empresa também oferece software SaaS B2B vertical que impulsiona os negócios de centenas de operadores de viagens terrestres em todo o mundo. Capacitamos os viajantes a descobrir novos destinos, construir conexões e experimentar o mundo — tudo isso enquanto fazem escolhas ambientalmente conscientes, promovendo um modo de transporte mais sustentável e acessível. Esta função está especificamente focada na Buson, nossa plataforma regional de mobilidade que torna as viagens de ônibus no Brasil mais inteligentes, acessíveis e convenientes.

A função

Buscamos um profissional para atuar no atendimento aos passageiros, garantindo suporte ágil e de qualidade. Será responsável por realizar trocas e cancelamentos de passagens, acompanhar solicitações e oferecer um atendimento multicanal humanizado, contribuindo para uma experiência positiva do cliente.

O que irá fazer

  • Realizar o atendimento das demandas internas relacionadas aos passageiros, garantindo agilidade e qualidade no suporte.
  • Executar cancelamentos e trocas de passagens, além de realizar a análise detalhada de pedidos.
  • Administrar e acompanhar tickets abertos por passageiros, assegurando a resolução dentro dos prazos estabelecidos.
  • Prestar atendimento aos clientes por meio de diversos canais, como telefone, WhatsApp, e-mail, entre outros, proporcionando uma experiência eficiente e humanizada.
  • Realizar atendimento personalizado ao cliente de novos produtos, esclarecendo dúvidas, oferecendo suporte e garantindo uma experiência positiva na utilização das soluções oferecidas.

O que buscamos

  • Atendimento ao SAC.
  • Análise de casos.
  • Vivência com atendimento multicanal.
  • Relacionamento com cliente.
  • Conhecimento intermediário no pacote office.
  • Customer Service (SAC).

Remuneração e Benefícios

  • Remuneração compatível com o mercado;
  • Benefício flexível por meio do cartão Swile;
  • Assistência médica Bradesco e odontológica com cobertura nacional;
  • Cultura remota em primeiro lugar: uma cultura colaborativa e inclusiva criada para equipes distribuídas
  • Ambiente descontraído e dinâmico;
  • Benefícios Sesc
  • Day Offs programados.
  • Fundo de bem-estar: subsídio anual para apoiar o seu bem-estar físico, mental e emocional

A Busbud está comprometida com a igualdade de oportunidades de emprego para todos os funcionários e com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho livre de discriminação e assédio. Todas as decisões de emprego na Busbud são baseadas nas necessidades da empresa, nos requisitos do cargo e nas qualificações individuais, independentemente de raça, cor, religião ou crença, nacionalidade, gênero, idade, deficiência, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, estado civil ou qualquer outra condição protegida pelas leis aplicáveis.

Customer Experience Analyst

Who We Are

Busbud is a global leader in ground travel mobility, with a mission to transform the way people connect around the world.

The group operates a B2C marketplace focused on booking intercity ground travel (bus, train, ridesharing, and more), used by over 100 million travelers across more than 3 million routes in over 80 countries.

The company also offers vertical B2B SaaS software that powers the businesses of hundreds of ground travel operators worldwide.

We empower travelers to discover new destinations, build connections, and experience the world, all while making environmentally conscious choices and promoting a more sustainable and accessible mode of transportation.

This role is specifically focused on Buson , our regional mobility platform that makes bus travel in Brazil smarter, more accessible, and more convenient.

The Role

We are looking for a professional to support passenger service, ensuring fast and high-quality assistance. This person will be responsible for processing ticket changes and cancellations, managing requests, and providing humanized, multichannel support — contributing to a positive customer experience.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Handle internal requests related to passengers, ensuring agility and quality in support.
  • Process ticket cancellations and exchanges, as well as perform detailed order analyses.
  • Manage and monitor tickets opened by passengers, ensuring resolution within established deadlines.
  • Provide customer service through multiple channels such as phone, WhatsApp, email, and others, delivering an efficient and humanized experience.
  • Offer personalized support for new products, addressing inquiries, providing assistance, and ensuring a positive experience with the offered solutions.

Who You Are

  • Customer Service (SAC) experience.
  • Case analysis skills.
  • Experience with multichannel customer support.
  • Strong customer relationship management skills.
  • Intermediate knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite.

What’s In It For You

  • Competitive compensation.
  • Flexible benefits through the Swile card.
  • National health Bradesco and dental care coverage
  • Remote culture first: a collaborative and inclusive culture designed for distributed teams
  • A dynamic and relaxed work environment.
  • SESC benefits.
  • Scheduled “Day Off” program.
  • Well-being fund: annual allowance to support your physical, mental, and emotional well-being

Busbud is committed to equal employment opportunities for all employees and to fostering a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. All employment decisions at Busbud are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion or belief, nationality, gender, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws.

description:

Atuar como desenvolvedor sênior em projetos de evolução, manutenção e suporte de sistemas Protheus, utilizando linguagem ADVPL, integrando com outros sistemas e promovendo melhorias técnicas e funcionais.

Diferenciais (Extras que agregam valor):

  1. Certificação TOTVS

  6. Inglês técnico ou fluente – útil para documentação ou atendimento de clientes internacionais
  7. Participação ativa na comunidade Protheus ou fóruns técnicos
  8. Vivência com metodologia ágil (Scrum, Kanban)

Localidade da posição: São Paulo ou Curitiba (Hibrido 2 ou 3 dias no escritório).

Por que construir sua carreira na Meta?

Oferecemos autonomia, metas claras e um ambiente dinâmico e desafiador, onde os profissionais têm oportunidade de interagir com diferentes tecnologias, participar de todos os tipos de projetos, trazer novas ideias e trabalhar de qualquer lugar do Brasil e (por que não?) do mundo. Além disso, somos uma das melhores empresas para se trabalhar no Brasil segundo o Great Place to Work e uma das 10 empresas que mais crescem no país há 3 anos consecutivos, segundo o Anuário Informática Hoje.

Quais são nossos valores?

- Pensamos e agimos como donos

Todas as pessoas são bem-vindas independentemente de sua condição, deficiência, etnia, crença religiosa, orientação sexual, aparência, idade ou afins. Queremos que você cresça conosco em um ambiente acolhedor e repleto de oportunidades.

title: Engenheiro de Segurança do Trabalho
description:
A GreenYellow é especializada em Eficiência Energética, Energia Solar, Comercialização e Gestão de Energia. De origem francesa, a empresa tem operações em oito países e possui um portfólio de Eficiência Energética com mais de 3 mil projetos implementados em todo o mundo, sendo mais de 1400 deles no Brasil, onde opera desde 2013.

Em energia solar, tem mais de 930 MWp globalmente e, no Brasil, possui mais de 70 usinas conectadas ou em implantação, somando 190 MWp de potência instalada. Atuando em toda a cadeia, a GreenYellow investe, desenvolve, constrói, e opera seus projetos no longo prazo.

Principais Responsabilidades

Segurança do Trabalho (Safety)

  • Coordenar e supervisionar os programas de segurança em todas as fases dos projetos – engenharia, construção, operação e manutenção.
  • Elaborar e implementar planos de resposta a emergências, planos de evacuação e simulados de crise, garantindo a prontidão das brigadas e dos recursos de segurança.
  • Conduzir investigações de incidentes e acidentes, identificando causas-raiz e assegurando a implementação de ações corretivas e preventivas eficazes.
  • Planejar e realizar inspeções e auditorias de campo, junto aos Técnicos de Segurança, assegurando o cumprimento das NRs aplicáveis (NR10, NR18, NR33, NR35, entre outras).
  • Garantir a conformidade com legislações e normas técnicas de segurança no setor de energia renovável, sistemas elétricos e ambientes industriais/comerciais, incluindo projetos com armazenamento de energia.
  • Apoiar as áreas de Engenharia, Construção, Operação e Manutenção na análise de riscos, controle documental e avaliação de contratadas sob aspectos de segurança.
  • Desenvolver e manter programas de segurança, incluindo o Programa de Gerenciamento de Riscos (PGR).

Saúde Ocupacional (Health)

  • Apoiar a elaboração e execução do Programa de Controle Médico de Saúde Ocupacional (PCMSO), em parceria com o médico do trabalho.
  • Monitorar e incentivar campanhas de vacinação, ergonomia, exames periódicos e programas de promoção à saúde e bem-estar.
  • Avaliar e controlar riscos ocupacionais (ruído, calor, agentes químicos, ergonômicos etc.), propondo e implementando medidas de mitigação.
  • Implementar e comunicar ações de conscientização sobre saúde mental, ergonomia e qualidade de vida no trabalho, alinhadas às políticas corporativas.
  • Participar de comitês de saúde e qualidade de vida, integrando indicadores de saúde ocupacional às metas corporativas de HSE.

ESG (Environmental, Social & Governance)

  • Atuar de forma integrada às metas ESG da empresa, apoiando o monitoramento e reporte de indicadores de sustentabilidade (carbono evitado, reciclagem, eficiência energética, diversidade e segurança).
  • Fornecer dados e análises técnicas para os relatórios anuais e/ou de sustentabilidade da empresa.
  • Colaborar com as áreas de Marketing e Responsabilidade Social Corporativa (CSR) na divulgação de resultados e boas práticas em ESG.
  • Apoiar a implementação de políticas e programas socioambientais, contribuindo para metas de neutralidade de carbono e segurança total.
  • Participar ativamente de auditorias e certificações ESG e de segurança (ex.: ISO 14001, ISO 45001).

Relacionamento com Stakeholders

title: Estagiário de desenvolvimento de software
description:

O Grupo Petrópolis é a única grande empresa do setor cervejeiro com capital 100% nacional. description:
Who are we?

Samsung Electronics has grown into one of the world’s leading technology companies, recognized as one of the top 5 global brands. As a global leader in technology, we are transforming the world with the creativity and diversity of our talented people who drive this transformation.

Our company's success reflects the determination and talent of our people, aligned with our key corporate values: People, Excellence, Change, Integrity, and Co-prosperity. Our mission is to help people achieve the impossible.

We are inspired by what people want to accomplish in their lives and work to create products that empower them in new ways. This drive fuels our innovation.

Join us at Samsung and find your opportunity to do what you can't.

Looking for more? Visit our website or our career page HERE !

Job Overview:

The Security & Loss Prevention Supervisor is responsible for leading the implementation of security services and asset protection across all logistics activities, including transportation, warehouses, and hubs. This role oversees the Security & Loss Prevention department, conducting audits and investigations to minimize potential losses for the organization. Coordinates responses to on-road incidents such as thefts, pilferages, and accidents, and evaluates vendors to identify vulnerabilities and propose mitigation strategies. As a key member of the logistics team, they collaborate with operational teams, internal departments like Legal and Finance, as well as external security authorities. Additionally, they work with internal and external stakeholders to continuously improve existing solutions, explore new approaches, conduct industry benchmarking, and track established metrics for loss prevention.

Key Job Responsibilities:

  • Be aware of the goals and direction of the Company and align all decisions and activities to support that direction and achieve the goals, which are key performance indicators, allowing performance improvements.
  • Lead investigations of internal and external occurrences, some cases involving police department in all states.
  • Serve as department’s liaison and security matter expert.
  • Develop business cases which receive the required approval, financial and technical resources, and the support of appropriate management to enact desired changes
  • Drive process improvements and increase efficiency by apply innovation initiatives (AI, drones, new technologies, etc.).
  • Designing and implementing the security and loss prevention strategy, standards and procedures.
  • Driving internal and external (vendors) audits to ensure that losses are kept at a minimal level.
  • Designing security procedures for all logistics processes, mainly for transportation and warehouses.
  • Effectively address security incidents. Detecting and addressing any discrepancies/pilferage for key metrics.
  • Participate in projects like warehouse layout (placement or cameras, security system, etc) and transportation monitoring center software as examples.
  • Background & Experience
  • A completed Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited university
  • Prior experience in law enforcement, asset protection, audit, risk management or other related security field
  • Familiarity with security equipment such as intrusion detection devices, access control systems, alarms, and CCTVs;
  • Results oriented leader that possesses strong influencing skill and is comfortable working in a fast-paced ambiguous environment while prioritizing and managing multiple responsibilities;
  • Analytical leader experienced in performance based, action and results oriented management, and effective problem-solver;
  • Ability to take calculated risks and challenge current practices to develop and deliver innovative solutions to meet or exceed the customer expectations.
  • English level intermediate is mandatory.

title: Monitoring Specialist
description:
About Playtech

Founded in 1999, the company has a premium listing on the Main Market of the London Stock Exchange and is focused on regulated and regulating markets across its B2B business. By leveraging its proprietary technology, Playtech delivers innovative products and services to ensure a safe, engaging and entertaining gaming experience.

As the gaming industry's leading technology company, it combines business intelligence-driven software, services, content, and platform technology to drive excellence and innovation across the sector. Read more about who we are and what we do here: and
Here at Playtech, we genuinely believe that people are our biggest asset. Diverse thoughts, experiences, and individual characteristics enrich our work environment and lead to better business decisions. Embracing differences and maintaining transparency in our processes is the core of Playtech's overall commitment to responsible business practices.

Ready to level up your career?

Playtech Managed Services Sao Paulo is looking for a proactive Monitoring Specialist with excellent communication, attention to detail, reaction time and problem-solving skills. Job Description

Your influential mission. You will...

  • Perform Monitoring, Incident Management, Redundancy and Incident Reporting activities.
  • Work on shifts (16/7 coverage ).
  • Monitor multiple business systems and detect incidents across multiple service dependencies.
  • React by executing appropriate redundancy protocols based on service type.
  • Coordinate incident communication with multiple parties.
  • Familiarize yourself with Incident Management documentation.
  • Learn the company products at a technical and operational level, including backend settings, integrations and monitoring dashboards.
  • Liase with third parties during Incident Management.
  • Understand how the environments and available configurations work.
  • Acquire insight into Incident Management processes in a global company.
  • Communicate daily with other teams in and outside the company.
  • Constantly develop skills and get new knowledge in the Incident Management domain.
  • Carry out investigations to determine Incident root causes.
Qualifications

Components for success. You...

  • Are willing to develop your career in Incident Management.
  • You have previous experience in Monitoring, Incident Management or a similar role (1 year minimum, 2 or more years recommended).
  • Possess knowledge of Monitoring and Incident Reporting methodologies and processes.
  • Have strong command of English for both written and spoken communication, ensuring clear and professional interaction with internal teams, clients, and external stakeholders.

You'll get extra points for...

  • Having experience working with Grafana or similar tools
Additional Information

Thrive in a culture that values...

  • A supportive and collaborative team environment.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development.
  • A commitment to innovation and excellence.
  • A diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone is welcome.
  • Comprehensive benefits and competitive compensation.

HOW TO APPLY?

In addition to your CV, please add a brief motivation letter covering your goals, your current experience in Monitoring or related fields, and/or working in a corporate environment. You can write it in the comment section at the end of the application page (under "your message to the hiring manager").

Kindly provide your resume in English.

MONITORING TEAM

The Monitoring Team is a crucial part of the Incident Report Operational Center (IROC). The team is dedicated to centralizing incident monitoring, detection, and initial response across all relevant systems. Our mission is to ensure business continuity and protect customer experience by proactively managing incidents. The team monitors all business systems, detects incidents across multiple service dependencies, and reacts by executing appropriate redundancy protocols based on service type. We manage incident communication and documentation across all service types and criticality levels.

Our team operates 16/7, ensuring immediate response and detailed incident reporting, documenting all actions and outcomes for transparency, accountability, and continuous improvement in incident management.

Join the team at our new Brazilian Playtech Managed Services (PTMS) office, where we work together to support and enhance our live products and services. Be part of a global, dynamic and innovative team that values collaboration, continuous learning, and excellence.

Playtech is an equal opportunities employer. Our mission is to welcome everyone and create inclusive teams. We celebrate differences and encourage everyone to join us and be themselves at work.

title: API Engineer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for API Designer/Engineer who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

Overview

The API Designer/Engineer is a pivotal role responsible for implementing API Design First principles to create scalable, secure, and consumer-centric APIs. The candidate will focus on designing API specifications and frameworks that ensure seamless developer experiences while meeting Customer's API standards and architectural guidelines.

Key Responsibilities

API Design & Development

  • Adopt an API Design First Approach : Leverage OpenAPI (Swagger), RAML, or AsyncAPI specifications to define APIs before implementation, ensuring clarity and alignment across stakeholders.
  • API Specification Creation : Design API specifications that adhere to Customer's API standards, covering endpoints, data structures, error handling, and response codes.
  • Policy Design and Configuration : Define and configure API policies (security, routing, transformation, throttling, etc.) using tools such as Azure API Management (APIM).
  • Mock API Development : Create mock APIs for early-stage validation and testing to facilitate integration and feedback before development.
  • API Testing : Perform unit testing of API specifications to ensure functionality, reliability, and adherence to defined standards.
  • Environment Configuration : Configure API backend settings within APIM (naming conventions, App Insights, Key Vault) in DEV, UAT, and PRD environments.
  • API Deployment : Deploy draft APIs into the Azure APIM Dev instance and promote them across DEV, UAT, and PRD environments using the API DevOps framework.
  • Documentation : Create comprehensive API documentation, including references, developer guides, and examples, in line with Customer's standards.
  • Metadata Publishing : Publish API Identity Cards (metadata, usage information) to the Azure API Management Developer Portal to enable easy discovery and adoption by consumers.

API Consumer Onboarding

  • Secure Authentication Setup : Configure OAuth/OpenID Connect to ensure secure authentication and authorization for API consumers.
  • Subscription Key Management : Share API subscription keys securely with consumers and maintain robust tracking mechanisms.
  • Integration Testing Support : Collaborate with API consumers during integration testing to resolve issues and provide guidance on proper usage.

Testing & Validation

  • Functional Testing : Conduct and support API functional, integration, and performance testing to validate API readiness and scalability.
  • Mock and Staging Environment Management : Ensure availability of mock services and staging environments for API testing and feedback gathering.

Skills and Expertise

  • API Design First Expertise : Proficient in designing APIs using OpenAPI, SwaggerHub, or similar tools with a focus on consumer-first design principles.
  • Azure API Management : Deep experience in configuring and managing APIs using Azure API Management.
  • Security Standards : Strong knowledge of OAuth2, OpenID Connect, and API key management best practices.
  • Documentation Excellence : Skilled in creating developer-friendly documentation and API identity cards.
  • Testing Proficiency : Familiarity with API testing frameworks and methodologies to validate functionality and performance. Proficient in using Postman tool

What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!
